policy: Nine credible publishing organizations were screened. Primary sources were read substantively; four selections are within 24 hours and two use justified extended fallback within 168 hours.

source_candidates.title: Cutting our inference bill by 68% by being obsessive about optimization
verified_facts: Cloudflare cut average AI code-review cost from $2.43 to $0.77 and median latency from 4:09 to 1:32 by trimming duplicate context, reducing model calls, changing model and effort choices, and simplifying reviewer code.
Treat token cost, latency and review quality as one evaluation.

source_candidates.title: Reducing Reward Hacking by Localizing Bad Behavior Instead of Penalizing It
verified_facts: Anthropic-affiliated researchers propose GRAFT, which routes gradients from monitor-flagged behavior into a FORGET adapter removed after training instead of penalizing detected hacks.
Replicate GRAFT only in a contained training study.

source_candidates.focus: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers
source_candidates.title: Unlock powerful insights and forecasts with Predictive AI Functions
verified_facts: Databricks introduced beta SQL functions for forecasting, driver analysis, anomaly detection, regression and classification, with results usable in queries, dashboards and Genie.
Give analysts one governed dataset and prediction question, then compare the built-in function with an approved baseline across backtests, missing data and business shocks.
source_candidates.freshness_reason: This 144-hour primary product release is within the permitted 168-hour extended fallback and was selected because no fresher verified source offered comparable, testable analyst workflow detail.

source_candidates.focus: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers
source_candidates.title: The missing chain of custody for enterprise AI — Why organizations must preserve the inputs, context and audit trail behind AI-generated business records
verified_facts: Reuters Legal commentary argues that consequential AI-generated business records may require more than the final document.
Classify AI uses by consequence, then preserve the minimum origin package for high-risk records: inputs, versions, outputs, edits, approvals and actions.
source_candidates.freshness_reason: This 120-hour expert analysis remains within the permitted 168-hour window and was selected for its concrete, source-specific governance checklist after fresher sources lacked equivalent preservation detail.

source_candidates.title: How to continue a GitHub Copilot app session in VS Code
verified_facts: GitHub’s tutorial shows how to open a Copilot app session in VS Code while retaining its conversation, code changes and working context.
Use session transfer as a review boundary.

source_candidates.title: Securing the agentic insider
verified_facts: Microsoft frames internally deployed agents as active enterprise participants that need identities, containers, permissions and continuous cross-layer observation.
Turn the control sequence into a read-only review skill: identify the agent and intended task, gather current signals, compare proposed action with permissions, and return allow, contain or escalate.
